policy: Investor due diligence. Flag fraud, misrepresentation, accounting irregularities, lawsuits, regulatory investigations, sanctions and adverse media.

policy_rules.what_counts: Company, its principals, or its affiliates are subject to credible allegations, charges, or findings of fraud, including securities, investment, or financial-statement fraud.
Company or principals are found, alleged, or publicly reported to have made false or misleading statements to investors, regulators, lenders, or counterparties.
Restatements, material weaknesses, auditor resignations or disagreements, unusual revenue recognition, or other red flags suggesting misstated financials.
Company or principals are defendants or plaintiffs in material litigation relating to investors, contracts, employment, IP, or business conduct.

Company or principals are the subject of an open or concluded investigation, inquiry, subpoena, cease-and-desist, or enforcement action by a financial, securities, consumer protection, environmental, or other regulator.
Credible news or reporting alleging misconduct, safety failures, labor abuses, environmental harm, or governance failures involving the company or principals.
Beneficial owners, directors, or officers have criminal convictions or pending charges for financial crime, fraud, or violent offenses.
Business activities involving the manufacture, sale, or distribution of weapons, ammunition, or firearms, or of key components for them.
Business activities involving the production or distribution of tobacco products or related components.
Business activities involving thermal coal mining, coal-fired power generation, or coal transport infrastructure.
Business activities involving the development or sale of surveillance technology or services, including monitoring systems used for mass or unlawful tracking.
Business activities involving casinos, online gambling, sports betting, or gambling-related products or services.
Beneficial owners, directors, or officers are current or former senior government officials, or their close family members or associates.
